payload.summary: The WA Mental Health Act forms register reports 0 forms while holding 54
payload.detail: Bare /forms/search renders '0 forms', a full column header row with no rows, no empty-state copy, and 'View all forms (0)'. ?q=transport returns 54 including 3A Detention and 4A Transport. forms-search-results-page.tsx:267 and :551 interpolate matches.length, which is 0 for an empty query; every sibling catalogue lists its contents instead. Reproduces at 390 and 1440. Supersedes the tablet-only scope of #6GR6B8, which is NOT closed.
